title: Decision
description: C-lane proposal to A for packages/contracts. Output of services/api/policy/director.decide(). A Decision is what the compositor should render (or the reason it should not). The policy is pure: the caller supplies clock, cameras and prior state; the Decision is derivable from those.

DecisionAction.description: TAKE: cut to camera_id. STAY: keep whatever is live. SLATE: no healthy source; render slate card.

camera_id.description: Target camera for TAKE/STAY. Null when action is SLATE.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason. Always non-empty. Surfaced to the producer log; not the model's chain-of-thought.

examples.reason: target sarah unusable; no healthy wide -> slate
